name: beads-box-widget
description: Renders the beads in-progress above-editor panel as a bordered box (pi-goal-x house style) by owning the 'beads-wip' widget slot at pi's widget-API boundary. Replaces @abix5/pi-beads' plain-line panel without touching upstream code; data comes from the public `bd` CLI. Required because pi-beads has no config knob to disable/restyle its widget.
